P_s1.explanation: A local, colour-blind detector of sharp straight edges and thin line structure, such as panel seams, slats, shelf and drawer grids, and window lattices. It also fires on the hard borders of photo frames and vignettes.

parsed.explanation: A local, colour-blind detector of sharp straight edges and thin line structure, such as panel seams, slats, shelf and drawer grids, and window lattices. It also fires on the hard borders of photo frames and vignettes.
parsed.evidence: The red boxes sit on straight contrast boundaries: lattices and slats in #1, #2, #7 and #16, and frame or vignette borders in #6, #10, #11 and #17, across unrelated objects. The unit keeps nearly all its activation under patch shuffle (100%) and grayscale (99%), but loses much under low-pass (33%), which points to a fine-scale local edge feature rather than an object.
